noah: quick question from my Barcelona trip. Hotel posted EUR 320 but my corp card shows an extra line "FX SURCHARGE EUR 10.24". do we reimburse or dispute?

tess: hi — do you have the hotel folio? if the folio lists the surcharge we reimburse, otherwise we usually open a dispute with Ramp/card issuer. can you upload both? :mag:

noah: uploaded folio (folio only lists EUR 320 room + tax). statement screenshot attached, last4 3412.

expense-bot: Please ensure both folio and card statement are attached to expense "BCN - Hotel - 2025-11-03". Missing docs will block dispute.

mike: thanks. i'll start a dispute with Ramp ops. disputes can take up to 15 business days. if Ramp denies, we'll reimburse you and try vendor recovery.

noah: prefer dispute first — don't want this in my per-diem.

tess: ticket opened FIN-2025-723. i'll update once Ramp responds. if they request manager approval to temporarily cover, i'll ping for sign-off. :thumbsup:
